stances.summary: China's manufacturing investment boom cannot sustain growth without real estate recovery
stances.quote:
China's current economic malaise in a nutshell -- rising investment in manufacturing can no longer offset the fall in investment in real estate.

The absolute level of investment in manufacturing is still absurdly high.  But it is now shrinking not growing.

stances.summary: Falling domestic demand undermines ability to maintain investment levels
stances.quote: Even with an unprecedented surge in auto exports (exports are growing at over 3m cars a year, Japan at its peak exported a total of 6m cars ... ) total auto production is flat, as domestic demand is falling.   Hard to keep investment up in that context ...
